newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 281,300 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 564,540 denars a week ago as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 290 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from the February 25 close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Alkaloid was the only company that traded at the previous session, selling 582 units.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
